claim: A block/unit/status name in sensor's third operand is a Content, not an LAccess attribute: it asks the building for a payload count, never for a property, and reads null on a building with no payload container.
why: Measured on v160.7: 'sensor x vault1 @hyper-processor' -> null, 'sensor n vault1 @copper' -> 100 and a vault holding no titanium -> 0. Item and liquid names are the legitimate inventory read (rules/sensor-item-read-is-fine) and are deliberately not reported. Evidence: out/takeover-20261024/15-sensor-link-oracle.md.
